title: Four runs of one person from the EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Dataset: one minute at rest with the eyes open and one with them closed, two minutes of opening and closing a fist, and two of imagining it; 64 channels of the 10-10 system at 160 Hz, with the cues as EDF+ annotations
provider: G. Schalk and colleagues (Wadsworth Center), recorded with BCI2000, served by PhysioNet
credit: EEG: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Dataset, subject 1 (Schalk et al. 2004), PhysioNet
format: EDF+C: 64 EEG channels of the 10-10 system (labels such as Fc5., Cz.., T10.) at 160 Hz in microvolts, and an EDF Annotations channel: T0 rest, T1 the onset of movement (real or imagined) of the left fist, T2 of the right fist (runs 3 and 4).
licence: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0 (PhysioNet, the dataset's page).
citation: Schalk, G., McFarland, D. J., Hinterberger, T., Birbaumer, N. and Wolpaw, J. R. (2004), BCI2000: a general-purpose brain-computer interface (BCI) system, IEEE Transactions on Biomedical Engineering 51, 1034-1043, doi:10.1109/tbme.2004.827072; Goldberger, A. L. et al. (2000), PhysioBank, PhysioToolkit, and PhysioNet, Circulation 101, e215-e220, doi:10.1161/01.cir.101.23.e215; the dataset: doi:10.13026/C28G6P.
